name: Voxel World 3D
description: Blocky voxel 3D style: flat-shaded sharp-edged blocks, a bright sunlit key, light fog and snap-in placement on twos, seen from a low hero angle (never isometric). A style only: the agent builds every block model, character and terrain from custom parts for each video. No emoji.
prompt_hint: 6-10 scenes (3-5 s). Each: title.kicker + title.main, visual.type "scene3d" with a `world` (concept, ground, parts built from boxes) and `custom` block objects designed for THIS video; no stock voxel character, trees or set. Vary the world and the subject from scene to scene. No emoji.
